_note: SCAFFOLD. In-game virtual currency only. No cash value; cannot be bought, sold, or redeemed for real money or crypto. Real-money features blocked until Law Bot review + Anterranian approval. See docs/modules/ECONOMY.md and docs/modules/ECONOMY_BANKING.md.

ledger_unit.note: Soft ledger unit (integer amounts). Physical coin/note art below is diegetic face for the same virtual economy. Pending: relationship of Embers / Phoenix God Coin / Aethel family.

aethel.tagline: Universal Currency / Universal Access (diegetic labels from concept art)
aethel.note: Strictly fictional game-only virtual currency and access tokens. No real-money purchase, cash-out, crypto minting, or external exchange. Stasis = stable soft currency; Ascendant = variable in-game asset (quest/trade value only); Key = wallet/access/ID card item.

roles.coins: Diegetic coin faces (lion coins; Stasis/Ascendant dragon coins).
roles.ascendant: Variable in-game asset face (Aethel-Ascendant); game balance only, not market-linked.
roles.key: Wallet / biometric access / ID card item (The Aethel Key).
roles.main_coin: Primary Aethel coin face (zodiac-rim dragon-phoenix; batch_26).

items.description: Gold-rimmed in-game coin. Obverse: embossed gold phoenix on black disc with magenta tech ring. Reverse: magenta figure-8 over gold galaxy spiral. Rim text (as printed): 'PHOENIX GOD, ANTERRANIAN MONACH' (sic MONARCH), 'DIVINE RIGHT', 'UNIVERSAL WEALTH'.

printed_text.note: Art prints MONACH (missing R); canonical title spelling is MONARCH. Same title family as batch_22 MONORCH typo.

items.notes: Game-only virtual currency token. Reinforces pending '8' question (reverse face). Not a real-world coin, NFT, or crypto asset. Pending: relationship to Aethel family (batch_24).

items.description: Magenta/purple fictional banknotes with gold borders, crowned phoenix central motif, cyan holographic security strip with circuit glyphs. Denominations 100 and 1000 visible. Bottom legend UNIVERSAL CURRENCY; upper arc may read AETHELIA / AETHEL-style script.

printed_text.upper_arc_note: Stylized AETHEL / AETHELIA-like script on art; treat as Aethel family branding.

items.notes: Diegetic note cosmetics for Aethel soft currency. Integer ledger only; no fiat value.

items.description: Pink disc coins with thick gold ridged rim and gold runic outer band. Obverse: crowned lion / beast head in profile (left-facing), gold on matte pink. Scattered pile on dark reflective surface.

printed_text.note: No clear Latin legend on art; lion meaning pending user confirmation.

items.notes: Pending Q: meaning of lion/beast crest vs phoenix/dragon national emblems. Game-only.

items.description: Square stamp/token sheet with ornate gold filigree borders and gear corners. Central circular window: crowned pink-gold phoenix on nebula. Overlay blue digital glyphs. Printed: AETHEL SIGIL / UNIVERSAL VALIDATION.
items.gameplay_use: In-game validation stamp / ledger receipt / quest completion token. Not a payment rail.
items.notes: Validation token only. No KYC, no real-world identity binding.

items.description: Circular coin: glowing magenta crowned dragon (winged, serpentine) in geometric seal rings on black. Gold rim. Top arc AETHEL-STASIS; bottom STABLE UNIVERSAL CURRENCY. Side monograms (stylized A).
items.gameplay_use: Stable soft-currency face for Aethel (integer balances; sinks/faucets via ledger). Not pegged to real money.
items.notes: Stable in-game currency. Distinct from Ascendant variable asset. Pending: relationship to phoenix_god_coin / Phoenix Embers.

items.description: Circular coin: glowing magenta crowned dragon with feathered wings; gold psi/trident-like marks. Top arc art prints AETHEL - ASCENDAND (sic ASCENDANT); bottom DYNAMIC UNIVERSAL ASSET. Gold geometric side filigree.

printed_text.note: Art spelling ASCENDAND (missing T); canonical ASCENDANT.

items.gameplay_use: Variable in-game asset (quest rewards, rare trade, prestige). Value floats only inside game balance rules — never linked to real markets or crypto.
items.notes: Dynamic = in-game variable only. Not a security, NFT, or exchange-traded token.

items.description: Black rectangular access/ID card with gold circuit etching and central magenta dragon/phoenix-dragon emblem. Hovering magenta holographic strip: THE AETHEL KEY / UNIVERSAL ACCESS, with biometric fingerprint swirl and handprint touch icon.
items.gameplay_use: In-game wallet / access / ID card item. Opens vaults, guild halls, capitol pads, suit lockers. Biometric UI is cosmetic fiction — no real biometric capture.
items.notes: Access/wallet item only. Not a real payment card, crypto wallet seed, or identity document.

items.description: Main Aethel coin face. Circular medallion: magenta crowned dragon-phoenix on dark disc; gold zodiac/alchemical glyph rim; top arc 'AETHEL COIN'; bottom 'UNIVERSAL CURRENCY'; outer glowing magenta ring. Cosmic nebula backdrop.
items.gameplay_use: Primary diegetic Aethel coin face for the soft virtual economy (integer ledger). Complements Stasis/Ascendant faces and Phoenix God Coin.
items.notes: Game-only virtual currency token. Label recorded as printed. Pending: how Aethel Coin relates to phoenix_god_coin / Embers / Stasis / Ascendant.
